name: Ibn Abi Dawud
bio: Abu Bakr Ibn Abi Dawud was born in Sijistan in 230 AH (844 CE). He travelled with his father Abu Dawud, compiler of the Sunan, hearing hadith from scholars in Egypt and Syria before settling in Baghdad. His Kitab al-Masahif gathers reports about the collection of the Quran and its early written copies. Al-Zirikli records that he lost his sight late in life. He died in Baghdad in 316 AH (929 CE).
